name: kaizen-board
description: 改善提案・困りごとボード (PWA + BFF + kintone)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
